# Scopes defaults (local)

Use Scopes as the navigation layer:

- If `Scopes/` exists: start from `Scopes/INDEX.md` and `Scopes/GRAPH.md`, then read the 1–3 most relevant `Scopes/Product/**` anchors before touching code.
- If `Scopes/` is missing or stale: run `/scopes:sync` before answering or implementing.
- Do not guess. If evidence is missing, write `[Unknown]` and stop.

When suggesting terminal commands, keep them copy/pasteable and safe by default.
